title:
Comment of Rachael Sadley in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 11/2/2026

documents.name: 152117.txt
documents.text:
Rachael Sadley, Anchorage, AK.
I do not believe that Alaska should allow data centers to be installed anywhere, especially the Cook Inlet. As an instrumental natural waterspace for salmon runs, beluga whales and other wildlife the damage caused by the installation of an unnecessary and wasteful operation such as a data center would have horrific consequences to Alaskas fisheries and biodiversity. 
NO TO DATA CENTER IN COOK INLET. NO TO DATA CENTERS.

Respectfully, 
Rachael Sadley
